subject: Upcoming Travel Plans
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to inform you that our upcoming trip to Hawaii has been finalized. We have booked flights for the dates of [date] to [date], and accommodations have been arranged at [hotel name]. I will send you a detailed itinerary soon. Please let me know if you have any preferences or need any additional information. Looking forward to a great vacation! Best regards, [Your Name]
